sources.title: 《秘書省續編到四庫闕書》雜類董子平條
sources.quality_notes: Registers 太陰三命歌 one juan without 闕 in this received item; adjacent 徐鑑 and 劉進平 titles show other natal-literature leads. No inference of extant copy now or precise Song folio.

sources.title: 葉德輝考證《宋秘書省續編到四庫闕書目》卷二
sources.quality_notes: Ye explicitly compares 歌 with 宋志 秘訣; neither the annotator nor the catalog title is an independent original text of the lost work. Distinguish 1903 print catalog from this digital transcription.

sources.title: 鄭樵《通志》卷六十八藝文略第六五行三命類
sources.quality_notes: Received entry 太陰三命歌一卷董子平撰; neighboring Xu Jian and Chen Fang entries correspond to Mishusheng sequence. Catalog dependence unresolved, not an independent work copy.

sources.title: 國圖來源《通志略（二十）》商務印書館萬有文庫印頁100
sources.quality_notes: PDF zero-index 0 cover identifies 萬有文庫 商務印書館; p101 printed page 一百 visibly reads 太陰三命歌一卷 and small 董子平撰; adjacent p100/p102 confirm pagination. Exact publication year, underlying edition, physical-copy identity and file hash not verified. Not a Song original glyph vote.

sources.title: 《宋史》卷206藝文志五行類董子平條
sources.quality_notes: Received entry 太陰三命秘訣 one juan; Shidian CADAL04201270 parallel received route corroborates. No original Yuan or Song folio, no proof 歌 and 秘訣 are separate works or identical text.
